title: Coding Tutor decision table
description: Slots (deciding details) -> codes. Each component has an ordered rule list; the first matching rule wins; the answer is the union across components. Structural checks live in engine/rules_engine.py.

question.description: what the student is asked; sets the scope so codes outside the table are not expected

evidence.description: value -> phrases a generated note must contain so the deciding detail is present: a list of strings = any one; a list of lists = one from EACH inner list

label.description: student-facing name of the deciding detail (UI hints)

labels.description: value -> student-facing wording (UI hints); never names a code

exclusive.description: default true: a note for one value must not contain phrases that belong only to the slot's other values

describe.description: value -> plain instruction for the note writer

note_forbid.description: phrases no generated note may contain (they would change the answer)

note_age.description: realistic patient age range for this topic's notes (e.g. dementia: 65 and over)

note_background.description: stable unrelated conditions a long note may mention for realism; each must leave the answer unchanged (outside the question's scope, no HCC)

note_rules.description: per-case overrides for note generation; every rule whose `when` matches applies

skip_evidence.description: slots whose evidence/exclusive checks are skipped

sex.description: the patient's sex when the case requires it (e.g. prostate or female-breast codes)

exclude.description: Partial slot assignments that are unrealistic; values may be strings or lists

when.description: slot -> value or [values]; omitted slots match anything

also.description: extra codes added to the distractor
